notes.title: Destiny Duel Championship #1
notes.content:
Destiny Duel championship coming up!

When
This Saturday 3/25 at 4PM EST.

Prize
 Discord role + Free Cosmetics Pack + $10.

Rules
- Format: Single Elimination / First to 2 for non-finals / First to 3 for finals
- Maps: Players choose / If can't agree then all maps
- Time Multiplier: Players choose / If can't agree then multiplier = 1
- Round duration: 30 minutes max / If match unfinished both players get a loss

To register, join the MBE Games Discord server and react to the announcement message in #dd-announcements. There is no entry fee.

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Players now have a set amount of time to ready up for a Ranked duel. Failure to ready up will now lead to a Ranked timeout

- Special music now plays when there are 2 players in a Ranked room

- Improved some UI elements and animations

- Reworked rematch availability in Ranked: after 10 consecutive duels in a Ranked room, rematch will not be available in that room
